sections.Profile:
Fun Land and Fun Park , both manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1968, are electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm. Fun Land is the replay version, while Fun Park is the add-a-ball version.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Carnival, Circus, Original Theme, Shooting, Fair, Theme park
